text: No, not all of the 2021 loss was inside the pine plantation. Of the 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss detected in 2021, 68.1 ha occurred within the pine plantation (_Pinus elliottii_ and _Pinus taeda_), while 13.2 ha occurred outside the mapped forest area. No loss was recorded in native forest zones. The evidence confirms that a significant portion (about 16%) of the loss happened outside the plantation boundaries.
